title: 29West protocol updates for changes through UM 6.17 release.
description:
lbmc:
  add ranged_rx flag to ume_capability_flags

lbmr:
  change reserved field in remote_domain_route_hdr to be "route_index"
    route_index is a decimal number
  add viral flag to the opt_local_domain_flags

lbmsrs:
  SRI - SRS Route Information message added
        Provides route information into local domain
  SRE - SRS Route End message added
        Provides notification that route is no longer available
  DMI - SRS Domain Information message added
        Provides notification of domains available to local domain
  CNI - SRS Context Name Information
        Provides domain ID, IP address, and port for named context
  CNQ - SRS Context Name Query
        Request for Information on a given context name
  CNE - SRS Context Name End
        Notification that a given named context mapping is now invalid

  Includes some compiler warning cleanups for global and local names being
  identical.

Global variables to control dissection do not work. When accessing packets in random order, or loading another capture file will give dissection errors.
These globals do not control dissection.  They are used to generate counts of elements within a given packet.
Removing this looses the registration of the dissector by name.

commits_data.message:
Code changes per code inspection comments.

Globally Revert whitespace changes - moving to separate change later.

Globally change leading tabs to spaces.

Add static declaration and comment to cnt_* globals within the packet-lbmsrs.c
so that these symbols will not pollute overall namespaace.

Revert removal of register_dissector() call.

Reword blurb for interest forward flag.

Remove globals for cntIdx and cntArr[] and remove commented out isMsgAvlbl() function.

commits_data.title: wmem: Add wmem_map_find function
commits_data.message:
wmem: Add wmem_map_find function

Add a function to search for a value in a map with that satisfies
a given function. This is O(N) to search the map, so it shouldn't
be routinely called for all values in the map (that's a sign that
the data structures need rethinking), but it can be useful.

commits_data.title: TCP: check first if a change is going to be made in the first place
commits_data.message:
TCP: check first if a change is going to be made in the first place

In all these blocks complex expressions are evaluated, but a change to
the tcp analysis data is only made when the frame was not yet visited.
Rather than doing all the work for nothing, first check if the frame
was visited, and only if not evaluate further.

had_acc_ecn_setup_syn and had_acc_ecn_setup_syn_ack tcp analysis data
fields not even took in consideration to only evaluate the first time
the frame is visited. These have now been included.

commits_data.title: 29West protocol updates for changes through UM 6.17 release.
commits_data.message:
29West protocol updates for changes through UM 6.17 release.

lbmc:
  add ranged_rx flag to ume_capability_flags

lbmr:
  change reserved field in remote_domain_route_hdr to be "route_index"
    route_index is a decimal number
  add viral flag to the opt_local_domain_flags

lbmsrs:
  SRI - SRS Route Information message added
        Provides route information into local domain
  SRE - SRS Route End message added
        Provides notification that route is no longer available
  DMI - SRS Domain Information message added
        Provides notification of domains available to local domain
  CNI - SRS Context Name Information
        Provides domain ID, IP address, and port for named context
  CNQ - SRS Context Name Query
        Request for Information on a given context name
  CNE - SRS Context Name End
        Notification that a given named context mapping is now invalid

  Includes some compiler warning cleanups for global and local names being
  identical.
